```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8

      - name: Format Python code
        run: |
          black challenges scripts
          isort challenges scripts

      - name: Check Python code style
        run: flake8 challenges scripts

  lint-cpp:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Clang
        uses: llvm/llvm-github-action@v0.4.0
        with:
          version: '11'

      - name: Format C++/CUDA code
        run: clang-format -i challenges/*.cpp challenges/*.cu scripts/*.cpp scripts/*.cu

  lint-mojo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Validate Mojo code
        run: |
          for file in challenges/*.mojo scripts/*.mojo; do
            if ! grep -q '@export' "$file"; then
              echo "Error: $file does not have @export decorator"
              exit 1
            fi
            if ! grep -q '^import' "$file"; then
              echo "Error: $file does not have standard imports"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
```
